description: Light twin standing in the main garden of Lemon Tree Hostel in Antigua Guatemala; beside the outdoor bar; used as a photo feature; in place since at least Aug 2022 (guatemala.com) and confirmed by an OSM survey in Mar 2026. The type and registration come from OSM node 13610218828; where the mapper recorded `description="Piper PA-23-250"` and `ref="YN-CAZ"` — almost certainly read off the airframe on site. I could NOT verify YN-CAZ against any Nicaraguan or international registry; accident database or fleet list; treat the registration as a sighted marking rather than a confirmed identity; and note the standing caution that painted markings on display airframes are frequently not the true identity. Why a Nicaraguan-registered airframe is sitting in Antigua is unresolved — an accident; an expired lease; an abandonment or a seizure are all plausible and none is evidenced. Construction number unknown; year_built blank; as no build date is sourced anywhere.
aliases: PA23; PA-23-250; PA23250; Aztec; YN CAZ; YNCAZ
